name: RFID/NFC Security Assessment
description: Security evaluation of RFID and NFC hardware implementations at the chip and protocol level. Covers contactless smart card security (MIFARE, DESFire, EMV contactless), RFID tag cloning, relay attack assessment, side-channel analysis of contactless interfaces, and evaluation of mutual authentication and session key establishment in NFC-based systems.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to RFID/NFC security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands RFID/NFC technology types and common security issues
evidence: Can explain LF (125kHz), HF (13.56MHz), and UHF RFID technology differences
Understands NFC communication modes (reader, card emulation, peer-to-peer)
Aware of historical RFID/NFC attacks (MIFARE Classic key recovery, relay attacks)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic RFID/NFC analysis using standard tools under supervision
evidence: Uses Proxmark3 to read, analyze, and clone LF and HF RFID tags
Captures and decodes NFC communication between card and reader
Performs known-key attacks on MIFARE Classic cards using documented procedures
Identifies RFID/NFC chip type and supported protocols from tag interrogation

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses RFID/NFC security including authentication and crypto implementations
evidence: Performs full security assessment of contactless smart card implementations independently
Assesses mutual authentication protocols and identifies weaknesses
Evaluates relay attack susceptibility with distance and timing measurements
Completed RFID/NFC security assessments on 3+ distinct systems with documented findings

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses hardened contactless implementations; combines with side-channel; mentors team
evidence: Performs power/EM side-channel analysis on contactless smart card crypto operations
Assesses proprietary contactless protocols through traffic analysis and reverse engineering
Develops custom NFC fuzzing and testing tools for the lab
Mentors team on RFID/NFC assessment methodology and tool usage

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on RFID/NFC security; publishes research; defines evaluation methodology
evidence: Published research on RFID/NFC vulnerabilities or attack techniques
Defines the lab's contactless security evaluation methodology
Provides expert consultation on contactless security to product designers and certification bodies
Develops novel RFID/NFC attack or assessment techniques

assessment_methods.description: Perform a full security assessment of a contactless system: identify the chip and protocol, assess authentication, test for cloning and relay susceptibility
Review RFID/NFC assessment reports for protocol analysis completeness and finding quality

equipment: Proxmark3 RDV4 with extended antenna set
Chameleon Ultra (or Mini/Tiny) for card emulation
